    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【EF Core】值转换器</span>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>好像有一个月没发文了，这期间发生了些不愉快的事。都是些家庭矛盾，不提也罢。</p>
<p>最近很多裁员，不要听网上的营销胡说九道。实际上很多裁员跟 AI 没多大关系的，要么是找个借口（拿AI做文章以掩盖公司实力不行了），要么是不行了，没钱了，项目烂了，公司也烂了，全烂了。如果经济形势大好的话，你看看那些B资本家会不会裁员？</p>
<p>----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p>
<p>好了，上面扯了堆没用的。下面咱们进入主题——值转换器。</p>
<p>从名字就知道，是用来给数据值做类型转换的。有大伙伴会问，是 .NET 类型与数据库类型吗？EF 自己不是有类型映射吗。老周觉得，准确地讲还真不是。应该说是 .NET 类型之间转换才对。不是吧，.NET 类型之间也要搞值转换器？对的，因为在 EF Core 的数据处理过程会有两个值：</p>
<p>1、Provider：这个不要以为是数据库的类型，其实是数据库映射到 .NET 的类型。比如，你数据库中某列的类型是 NVARCHAR，那在 .NET 中就是 String；</p>
<p>2、Model：这个是你定义的实体类中，某个属性的类型。</p>
<p>通常情况，你实体类中的属性类型，和数据库提供者映射的 .NET 类型是一致的。比如，你有一个实体中，Age 属性的类型是 int，那么，数据库中的类型是 INT。这种情况下，你的属性和数据库默认映射的 .NET 类型是一样的，不考虑值转换器。</p>
<p>但，凡事总有例外的。比如，你的某个属性类型是枚举，而数据库中对应列是 VARCHAR 类型，这使得默认映射的 .NET 类型是 String。而你是想着在存入数据库时，使用枚举的成员名称。这里头就需要一个“中间人”角色，在写入数据库时，将枚举值对应的成员名称转为字符串；从数据库查询（读）时，将字符串重新 Parse 为枚举值。</p>
<p>再比如，你的实体中有个表示坐标的属性，类型是 Point 类，可它只有 X 和 Y 两个属性，你觉得没有必要把 Point 也当成实体，没必要在数据库中为它建表。其实只要转为像“100，85”这样的字符串，然后以文本方式保存到数据库；读出来的时候，还原回 Point 对象就好了。</p>
<p>咱们来演示一下。首先，在 SQL Server 中执行以下脚本，创建测试用的数据库。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">USE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> master;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">DATABASE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> my_doudou_db;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">USE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> my_doudou_db;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">dbo</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.tb_ufo
(
    id </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">INT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">IDENTITY</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span>,             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> ID</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">desc</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NVARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">150</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span>,        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> UFO是什么样子的</span>
    discover <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NVARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">20</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span>,       <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 谁发现了UFO</span>
    pos <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NVARCHAR</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">64</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span>,            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> UFO被发现时所在位置</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 主键</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Ufo_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">primary</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">key</span> (id <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">asc</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">GO</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后定义实体类—— Ufo。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表示位置坐标的结构
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Point
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> X;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Y;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Ufo
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标识
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> UFO描述
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Desc { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 发现者
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Discover { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> UFO位置
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Point Pos { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>注意，咱们这里用 Point 结构来表示坐标，但在数据库中是文本类型。毕竟咱们没必要为 Point 单独做表映射，更何况结构是不能进行映射的。所以，这里头就需要做转换了。可以看到，值转换有时候不一定只是类型转换，也可能用于转换数据值的表示格式。</p>
<p>在派生 DbContext 类时，重写&nbsp;OnModelCreating 方法，实现模型配置。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext : DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置连接字符串</span>
        optionsBuilder.UseSqlServer(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Data Source=(localdb)\\MSSQLLocalDB;Initial Catalog=my_doudou_db;Integrated Security=True</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span> 转换方法
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PointToStr(Point p)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{p.X},{p.Y}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Point StrToPoint(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> idx = s.IndexOf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(idx &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> || idx &gt; s.Length - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Point();
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> c1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.Parse(s.Substring(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, idx));
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> c2 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.Parse(s.Substring(idx + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Point { X = c1, Y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> c2 };
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endregion</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Ufo&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 属性与列映射</span>
            ent.Property(x =&gt; x.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(x </span>=&gt; x.Desc).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">150</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">desc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(w </span>=&gt; w.Discover).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">discover</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(d </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> d.Pos)
                 .HasColumnType(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">nvarchar(64)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                 .HasColumnName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pos</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 转换器</span>
                 <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.HasConversion(
</span></span>                    <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">m </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PointToStr(m),
</span></span>                    <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">p </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StrToPoint(p)
</span></span>                 <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span></span></strong>            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置主键</span>
            ent.HasKey(d =&gt; d.Id).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Ufo_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 映射表名</span>
            ent.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_ufo</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据集合，查询访问入口
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DbSet&lt;Ufo&gt; Ufos { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>其他配置相信大伙伴们都很熟了，这里重点关注值转换器的配置。主要通过&nbsp;HasConversion 方法实现。这个方法的重载可多了，本次示例咱们用的是以下重载：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">virtual</span> PropertyBuilder&lt;TProperty&gt; HasConversion&lt;TProvider&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
    Expression</span>&lt;Func&lt;TProperty, TProvider&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> convertToProviderExpression,
    Expression</span>&lt;Func&lt;TProvider, TProperty&gt;&gt; convertFromProviderExpression);</pre>
</div>
<p>这个版本之所以简单，就在于不用定义新类型，直接使用两个委托传参。此处，类型参数&nbsp;TProperty 指的是实体类中属性的类型，而&nbsp;TProvider 自然就是数据库提供者默认所需要的类型。本示例中，TProperty 是 Point，TProvider 是 String。</p>
<p>所以，第一个委托绑定的方法应该以 Point 为输入类型，返回 String；第二个委托是以 String 为输入，返回 Point 结构实例。</p>
<p>私有方法&nbsp;PointToStr 和&nbsp;StrToPoint 用于实现转换逻辑。</p>
<p>1、Point 转为字符串比较简单，直接变成 100,200 的形式即可（用逗号隔开）；</p>
<p>2、字符串转回 Point 实例。老周用了简单的方法，在字符串搜索逗号，记录它在字符串中的位置。接着，逗号左边的就是X坐标，右边的就是Y坐标。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Point StrToPoint(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> idx = s.IndexOf(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">,</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 逗号不应该出现在开头或结尾</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(idx &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> || idx &gt; s.Length - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Point();
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 取逗号左边的子串</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> c1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.Parse(s.Substring(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, idx));
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 取逗号右边的子串</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> c2 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.Parse(s.Substring(idx + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Point { X = c1, Y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> c2 };
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>如果你觉得&nbsp;StrToPoint 的实现不够逼格，那也可以改用正则表达式来处理字符串。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> Point StrToPoint(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> res = Regex.Match(s, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">(\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(\\d+)</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(res.Success &amp;&amp; res.Groups.Count &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> x = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.Parse(res.Groups[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Value);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> y = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.Parse(res.Groups[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Value);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Point { X = x, Y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> y };
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Point();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>\d+ 表示至少出现一个数字字符，加括号代表数字字符为一个分组。后面可通过 res.Groups 集合获取。中间的 \s*,\s* 代表逗号两边可能有空格。Groups 集合中会包含三个结果，第一个元素是匹配的整个字符串，不是咱们所需要的，咱们要的是包含数字的两个分组。所以应从 Groups 集合的第二个元素起获取坐标值。</p>
<p>如果你希望值转换器具有独立性或者能通用于其他代码，咱们可以封装一下，让其变成一个类——派生自&nbsp;ValueConverter&lt;TModel, TProvider&gt; 类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> MyValueConverter : ValueConverter&lt;Point, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#region</span> 两个转换方法移到这里
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">PointToStr</span>(Point p)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> $<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{p.X},{p.Y}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> Point <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">StrToPoint</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> res = Regex.Match(s, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(\\d+)\\s*,\\s*(\\d+)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (res.Success &amp;&amp; res.Groups.Count &gt;= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> x = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.Parse(res.Groups[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Value);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> y = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>.Parse(res.Groups[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Value);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Point { X = x, Y =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> y };
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Point();
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endregion</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 构造函数</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyValueConverter()
        : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
                <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><strong>p </strong></span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><strong>=&gt;</strong></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><strong> PointToStr(p)</strong></span>,
                <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><strong>s </strong></span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><strong>=&gt;</strong></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><strong> StrToPoint(s)</strong></span>
            )
    { }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>ValueConverter 的构造函数需要两个委托作为表达式，其含义和前面&nbsp;HasConversion 方法调用时一样：第一个委托表示实体属性的 Point 类型转换为数据库所需要的 String；第二个委托则是查询数据时，从数据库读取的 String 到实体属性的 Point 类型。</p>
<p>顺便把两转换方法也移到 MyValueConverter 类中，这样能成为一个整体。</p>
<p>回到 OnModelCreating 方法，咱们依旧使用 HasConversion 方法进行配置。这个方法有几十个生载呢，它支持咱们自定义的转换类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>modelBuilder.Entity&lt;Ufo&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 属性与列映射</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ……
    ent.Property(d </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> d.Pos)
         .HasColumnType(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">nvarchar(64)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
         .HasColumnName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pos</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
         .<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><strong>HasConversion</strong></span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><strong>&lt;MyValueConverter&gt;</strong></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><strong>()</strong></span>;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置主键</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ……
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>以上转换器配置均针对Ufo单个实体的，不过，有些时候，Point 可能用在多个实体中。这种情况没必要逐个实体去配置转换器（除非特定需求），使用批量配置更方便。这就要用到约定了。在 EF Core 中，约定仅用于自动发现和配置实体，也可以用于批量配置。</p>
<p>配置方法：在 DbContext 派生类中重写&nbsp;ConfigureConventions 方法，然后调用&nbsp;ModelConfigurationBuilder.Properties 方法完成属性配置。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigureConventions(ModelConfigurationBuilder configurationBuilder)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.ConfigureConventions(configurationBuilder);
    configurationBuilder.Properties</span>&lt;Point&gt;(p =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置值转换器</span>
        p.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HaveConversion&lt;MyValueConverter&gt;</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">()</span></strong>;
    });
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这样配置后，只要实体中有属性是 Point 类型的，都会自动配置值转换器。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p>
<p>EF Core 自身也内置了许多值转换器。因此，许多常用且简单的转换，不需要调用&nbsp;HasConversion 方法进行配置，EF Core| 自己会完成配置。</p>
<p>&nbsp;1、string 与 char 类型的转换：当从 string 转换为 char 时候，若原字符串长长度大于 1，只返回字符串中第一个字符。</p>
<p>2、DateOnly 与 String 类型的转换：转为字符串时调用 ToString 方法。从字符串中取回 Datelnly 时，调用&nbsp;DateOnly.Parse 方法。</p>
<p>3、DateTimeOffset、TimeOnly、TimeSpan、Datetime 与 string 之间的转换与 DateOnly 与 string 的转换一样。</p>
<p>4、GUID 与 String 之间的转换。转为字符串时调用 ToString 方法；string 转换回 GUID 时调用 Guid 类的构建函数。</p>
<p>5、枚举与文本变量间的转换。转换为字符串时直接应用 ToString 方法；反过来可用&nbsp;Enum.TryParse 方法。</p>
<p>&nbsp;6、数值类型与 string 间的转换。数值类型包括 int、long、short、byte、decimal、float、double 等，转为字符串时用的并不是 ToString 方法，而是 Format 方法；从 string 转回数值类型时，调用的是 Parse 方法。</p>
<p>7、Uri 与 string 之间的转换。转为字符串时直接用 ToString 方法，反过来用的是 Uri 构造函数，把字符串传给它。</p>
<p>8、bool 类型。整数 0、1，字符串“true”"false""True""False""Y""N" 都能转为 bool 类型。</p>
<p>9、字节数组可以与 base64 字符串之间转换。使用的是&nbsp;Convert.ToBase64String 和&nbsp;Convert.FromBase64String 方法。</p>
<p>&nbsp;……</p>
<p>&nbsp;这么转换的，怎么记啊？去！记它干吗，用就是了，要是哪里不能转换了，它会报异常，到时候再自己实现自定义就好了。</p>
<p>下面老周举个栗子：使用到 Uri 与字符串的转换，以及 byte[] 与字符串的转换。由于是内部支持的，所以不需要配置任何转换器。</p>
<p>好，习惯性流程，咱们过一遍。</p>
<p>1、写实体类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WebImage
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Id { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Uri Source</span></strong> { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? Alter { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> required <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span>[] InnerData</span></strong> { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>Source 和 InnerData 属性需要值转换器，但 EF Core 自动处理。</p>
<p>2、数据库上下文。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext :DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 连接字符串</span>
        optionsBuilder.UseSqlServer(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Data Source=(localdb)\\MSSQLLocalDB;Integrated Security=True;database=demo</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;WebImage&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 常规套路，配置属性与列映射</span>
            ent.Property(x =&gt; x.Id).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(f </span>=&gt; f.Source).HasColumnType(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">varchar(150)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">i_src</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(s </span>=&gt; s.Alter).HasMaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">alt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            ent.Property(j </span>=&gt; j.InnerData).HasColumnType(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">varchar(MAX)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">_data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主键</span>
            ent.HasKey(k =&gt; k.Id).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Img</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表名</span>
            ent.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">t_webimgs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数据集合</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> DbSet&lt;WebImage&gt; WebImages { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>3、运行时创建数据库，并写入两条记录。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext();
context.Database.EnsureCreated();

<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">context.WebImages.AddRange([
        </span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> WebImage{Source = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Uri(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://2233.org/bbk</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>), Alter=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">abc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, InnerData = [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x43</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x55</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x2d</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x8a</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xa6</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x07</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x11</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]},
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> WebImage {Source=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Uri(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://zzz.net/om/x/1/xt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>), Alter=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mxk</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, InnerData = [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x84</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x12</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x7c</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xe4</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0xf1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x03</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x15</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x09</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x6b</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">]}
    ]);</span></strong>
context.SaveChanges();</span></pre>
</div>
<p>4、运行。然后咱们去数据库里看看。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">use</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> demo;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">select</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">*</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> t_webimgs
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">go</span></pre>
</div>

<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202605/367389-20260506122525874-1418986372.png" alt="image" width="350" height="59" loading="lazy"></p>
